title: Richard Bar abducted at Vandenberg

tellings.quote: Also in September of 1964 at Vandenberg, another missile security officer, Richard Bar, was taken aboard a craft with four alien beings.

I actually just interviewed a guy named Richard Barth who the same month in September of 1964 was stationed at Vandenberg Air Force Base and was abducted and taken on a craft while he was guarding a missile station.
tellings.difference: Says Michels interviewed Barth himself and that he was guarding a missile station; it does not mention the four beings.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Richard Barth/Bar being taken aboard a craft at Vandenberg in September 1964 while on missile security duty.

as_told.title: Richard Barth abducted while guarding a missile at Vandenberg

tellings.quote: I was just terrified and next thing I know I'm out, you know, and I don't know if I passed out or [clears throat] it's just blank at that point. Then I come to and I'm inside this it's a circular room.
tellings.difference: Told firsthand by Barth, adding that he blacked out and came to inside a circular room.
tellings.link_reason: Barth's own account of the same 1964 Vandenberg abduction, describing blacking out and waking in a circular room.

as_told.title: Barth clip: waking inside a circular room

plain: In September 1964, a missile security officer named Richard Barth says he was taken aboard a craft while guarding a missile station at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California. Barth tells Michels firsthand that he was terrified, then everything went blank, and he came to "inside this... circular room"; Michels, who interviewed him, adds that four alien beings were aboard. If true, it would mean aliens seized a guard at a US nuclear missile site.
